messages:
Marta: Quick async check-in — wrapping up Python quickstart packaging. Fixed wheel build by adding MANIFEST.in but need another pair of eyes on the README auth snippet (token examples). Also sampleapp e2e is hitting a rate-limit in CI job macos-e2e. cc @Dan @Jules

Dan: On it. I can review the README snippet this afternoon, ping me when PR is up.

Jules: Saw the MANIFEST change in the branch. Minor comment about package_data path, pushed a suggestion to the PR. CI rate-limit — which job is failing? job 3 or job 5?

Marta: job 3 (macos-e2e). Log shows 429 on /v1/generate after ~120 requests. Could be test harness hammering the hosted quotas. We can either slow the tests or use a sandbox token.

Tian: FYI I rebased the sampleapp branch onto main earlier; bumped node to 18 in package.json so some CI runners may rerun installs. If you see spurious failures that's why.

Jules: Re: token names in examples — quickstart currently uses REDWOOD_API_KEY but our SDK also supports RW_API_KEY env var. I can add an alias snippet so both work:
```js
const key = process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY || process.env.RW_API_KEY;
```
That keeps old examples working.

Dan: I like the alias approach. Also tiny nit in the README: prefer `requestTimeout` default to 30s in the code sample. I'll add that in my review.

Marta: Thanks — blocker: need a console screenshot for the billing section in the docs (one 800x450 PNG). @Jules can you capture and drop to docs-assets?

Jules: Yep, will grab an export and upload to docs-assets by EOD.

samir-bot: Build status: PR #412 — unit tests passed, integration tests queued. :white_check_mark:

ci-bot: Lint check: markdown link formatting (docs/quickstart.md) — minor fix suggested.

Dan: I'll approve PR #412 once integration tests finish and then push a tiny patch for the README timeout and the env alias.

Marta: Plan for today: merge PR, update README with Dan's patch, rerun CI with sandbox token for e2e to confirm rate-limit fix, then follow up on the sampleapp node bump if CI flakes.

Tian: If you want I can temporarily point job 3 to the sandbox token to unblock.

Marta: That would help, thanks. No other blockers from my side.

Dan: Will do review in ~30m.

Jules: Screenshot done, uploaded to docs-assets/billing-panel-800x450.png.

Marta: Awesome — thanks everyone :rocket:
